help.out:
sgt — semantic operation-ideal version control

  the daily spine (a selection — symbol / glob / NL / feature / set — is the argument):
  sgt save [-m "<msg>"]       mine the working tree + commit a witness (auto-matches plan steps)
  sgt log [--json]            the lane×commit grid — the one inspection surface:
                              --tree (feature tree) · --rail (episode rail) · --summary
                              (status scalars) · --ops (raw op DAG) · --rebuild (recluster)
  sgt undo                    invert the last mutating operation (the unified op log)
  sgt revert <sel> [--emit]   remove a selection and everything built on it (I \ upset X)
  sgt restore <sel> [--emit]  re-add a selection and its prerequisites (I ∪ downset X)
  sgt resolve <symbol>        guided same-symbol fork resolution (merge-op → fulfill → land)

  navigation + inspection:
  sgt switch <branch>         move HEAD to a branch's committed tree (mines both ends)
  sgt diff <ref_a> <ref_b>    semantic diff: the symmetric difference of two ideals
  sgt intent <cmd>            per-feature checkpoints (intent segments): list/show/build;
                              rewind one with `sgt revert <feature>@<n>`

  agentic loop:
  sgt plan <cmd>              intake/abandon/status a stated plan's predicted hollow ops
  sgt save --resolve-plan     settle an ambiguous plan-step match a save couldn't auto-confirm

  groupings:
  sgt feature <cmd>           author/re-cut features: regroup (merge/split/move),
                              rename, select, why
  sgt advanced <cmd>          maintenance/rare verbs: blame, edit, fulfill, commit, fsck,
                              reindex, state, oracle, after, fold, preview, tiers,
                              identity, migrate, history, compose, forks, review-queue,
                              unstage, repair, merge-op, split-op, transplant

  collaboration + setup:
  sgt sync [remote] [branch]  fetch + merge a teammate's work; union ops, reconcile, fork
  sgt land <branch> [--json]  advance a shared branch record by CAS, gated oracle-green
  sgt push [remote] [branch]  non-forcing git push; a rejection routes you to `sgt sync`
  sgt propose <cmd>           a base+Δ review object: create/status/land/render/publish
  sgt session <cmd>           named scratch-tree lifecycle: start/status/land/gc
  sgt init [path] [--horizon <ref>]   bind git + the kernel op store; mine existing history
  sgt mcp [path]              run the MCP stdio server for coding-agent clients
  sgt git <args...>           pass through to real git (refuses tree-mutating verbs)

  <sel> resolves an op-id / prefix, a `file::name` symbol, a glob, a feature id/label, or
  an NL phrase; read verbs take --json for the machine-readable sgt.api projection.
